Package neqsim.process.equipment.distillation

Class SarirAtmosphericMainSteamScreen

java.lang.Object
neqsim.process.equipment.distillation.SarirAtmosphericMainSteamScreen
public final class SarirAtmosphericMainSteamScreen extends Object
Source-bounded main-column steam-injection screening for a SarirAtmosphericFractionationCase.

The Sarir source publishes a main-column steam rate, temperature, and pressure, but it does not publish an injection tray, steam quality, enthalpy, or a complete thermodynamic state. This class therefore requires a bottom-up NeqSim tray index, an explicit interpretation of the reported pressure basis, and an independently prepared, single-gas-phase water stream from the caller. A non-blank state-basis description is retained as auditable engineering provenance.

The two published side-stripper rows are outside this class because the qualified Sarir case does not yet model either side stripper. They are never redirected into the main column.

  • Method Details

    • configure

      public static SarirAtmosphericMainSteamScreen configure(SarirAtmosphericFractionationCase fractionationCase, int injectionTrayIndex, StreamInterface preparedSteam, SarirAtmosphericMainSteamScreen.ReportedPressureBasis reportedPressureBasis, String thermodynamicStateBasis)
      Attach an explicit prepared steam stream to an unsolved qualified Sarir atmospheric case.
      Parameters:
      fractionationCase - unsolved qualified Sarir atmospheric-fractionation case
      injectionTrayIndex - explicit bottom-up NeqSim tray index
      preparedSteam - independently prepared material stream at the published rate, temperature, and pressure, with exactly one gas phase and essentially pure water composition
      reportedPressureBasis - explicit engineering interpretation of the source pressure column
      thermodynamicStateBasis - non-blank description of the independent quality, enthalpy, or state evidence used to prepare the stream
      Returns:
      configured source-bounded screen
      Throws:
      NullPointerException - if the case or stream is null
      IllegalArgumentException - if the tray, basis, or stream boundary is invalid
      IllegalStateException - if the source boundary changed, the case was solved, or the column already has an additional feed
